risk_note: RV2 (risk-scan chain self-heal; BR-ID-36 freeze expiry and daily alerts keep running; no migration). The worker re-queues each chain's next time slot every 5 minutes with the chain's own singleton key: deduplicated by the exclusive risk-scan queue while the chain is healthy, restarts a chain broken by a failed re-enqueue; the current slot is never re-queued (no duplicate daily alerts). A failed re-queue only warns, the other chain still goes; the timer stops before the services stop and is unref'd. B1-03j behaviour and frozen tests unchanged. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
